rule_description: Knitted jersey from Indonesia qualifies under CPTPP agreement
required_documents: Certificate of origin; packing list; commercial invoice
eligibility_criteria: CPTPP Rules of Origin: Indonesia operations meet substantial transformation and 60% RVC requirements

rule_description: Women's skirts from Indonesia under CPTPP with lower RVC requirement
required_documents: CPTPP certificate of origin; bill of materials; invoice
eligibility_criteria: CPTPP-eligible manufacturing in Indonesia meets 55% regional value content and substantial transformation criteria

rule_description: Knitted garments (chapter 61): manufacture from yarn. The fabric must itself be knitted in Vietnam or the UK from yarn; cutting and sewing alone from imported fabric does not confer origin.
required_documents: Origin declaration or certificate of origin; supplier statements for fabric and yarn origin
eligibility_criteria: All fabric must originate in Vietnam or the UK (bilateral cumulation). Up to 10% by weight of non-originating materials is tolerated.
how_to_qualify: Garments made in Vietnam from Chinese fabric do not qualify. Either buy fabric knitted in Vietnam or the UK, or keep non-originating inputs under 10% by weight. Otherwise pay the full duty rate.

rule_description: Woven garments (chapter 62): manufacture from yarn. Fabric must be woven in Vietnam or the UK; cut-and-sew from imported fabric does not confer origin.
required_documents: Origin declaration or certificate of origin; supplier statements for fabric and yarn origin
eligibility_criteria: All fabric must originate in Vietnam or the UK. Up to 10% by weight of non-originating materials is tolerated.
how_to_qualify: Garments made in Vietnam from Chinese fabric do not qualify. Source fabric woven in Vietnam or the UK, or keep non-originating inputs under 10% by weight.

rule_description: Knitted garments: single transformation. Cut-and-sew in Bangladesh from imported fabric qualifies under the LDC rule.
eligibility_criteria: Manufacture in Bangladesh by a registered exporter; no minimum local fabric content.
how_to_qualify: Nothing to change; keep the registered exporter statement on the invoice.

rule_description: Knitted garments: manufacture from yarn. Fabric must be knitted in Turkey, the UK or the EU.
eligibility_criteria: Fabric from Turkey, the UK or EU cumulates; third-country fabric does not.
how_to_qualify: Use Turkish, UK or EU fabric.
